title: Bump GitHub Actions to Node.js 24-supporting versions
description: GitHub deprecated Node.js 20 actions; runners will force Node 24 starting 2026-06-02 and remove Node 20 entirely 2026-09-16. Each pinned action below needs a major-version bump once an upstream Node-24 release is available. Dependabot is configured (.github/dependabot.yml) to auto-PR weekly; merging a PR satisfies the corresponding child bead.
